messages:
alex r: Quick heads-up — vendor-tier changed their nightly billing/alloc window to 00:00-02:00 UTC last night and flipped the telemetry tag schema. I noticed a couple of tenants reported odd allocation drops around 00:45 UTC. Can infra confirm allocation mapping still matches our cost telemetry?

maria g: saw the tag change in the CSV dump. allocate_tag -> alloc_id now; mapping script expects allocate_tag. PR to update parser incoming.

ken: pinging because we have a demo canary that hit an eviction at 00:47. Not sure if it was preemptible churn or a vendor-side throttle. Vendor status showed brief "maintenance" spike at 00:45.

alex r: @ken can you paste the eviction log excerpt here? would help correlate with vendor event.

ken: sure —
```
2026-05-12T00:47:13Z evict: instance-id=i-0abc123 tenant=acme-demo pool=spotpool reason=preempted
2026-05-12T00:47:14Z trace: infra-agent reconnect attempt=1
```

sasha: also saw alerts in the billing app: allocation_id now null for ~6% of requests between 00:30-01:10 UTC. suspect our ingestion dropped new tag. I queued a small fix to rename the env var and add a fallback.

maria g: PR is #8423 (parser: accept new alloc_id and fallback to allocate_tag). It includes a one-line migration script to backfill last 72h.

alex r: thanks. Two asks: (1) can oncall confirm no SLA breach for Dedicated pools (we had a 99.9% latency/availability SLO)? (2) can SRE open a vendor ticket asking for exact start/end and whether they retroactively re-tagged events? we need it for invoice reconciliation.

oncall: checking SLO dashboards now. quick answer: Dedicated availability stayed at 99.95% for the day. there was a 1m blip in preemptible pools only. filing vendor ticket as INF-2026-331.

vendor-bot: Ticket INF-2026-331 created with vendor support (ref VND-8462). Link: https://vendor.example.com/tickets/VND-8462

ken: thanks. if vendor confirms it was a tagging change, we should coordinate a config rollout to avoid future gaps — maybe run parser update as a quick rollbackable canary on staging at 11:30 PDT?

alex r: sounds good. maria, can you schedule the staging canary and add a telemetry assertion test? (assert: allocation_id != null for sample stream).

maria g: will do. scheduling canary for 18:30 UTC (11:30 PDT). adding assertion and smoke test in the PR.

alex r: great. i'll draft a short ops note for finance to explain the temporary mis-tags if vendor doesn't reprocess. cc @finance.

sasha: one more nit — add the vendor region tag to the backfill (eu-west/us-east) so invoices map cleanly. PR updated.

alex r: perfect. closing loop here — will update thread when vendor responds or after the canary run. :thumbsup:
